name: Belt of Dwarvenkind

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: +2 Constitution (to 20), Darkvision 60 ft, Advantage on saves against poison and Resistance to it, Dwarvish.
text: Wearing this belt brings several benefits. Your Constitution rises by 2, to no more than 20. Your Charisma (Persuasion) checks to deal with dwarves have Advantage. Saving throws to resist or shake off the Poisoned condition have Advantage, and you gain Resistance to Poison damage. You also gain Darkvision out to 60 feet, and you can read, write and speak Dwarvish. While attuned, each dawn brings a 50 percent chance that you sprout a full beard if you're able to grow one, or that an existing beard grows visibly thicker.
